notes: Printed: 'Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, this creature deals 1 damage to any target.' Seat 0 controls seat 1's Ogre (a control effect: controlled_by) and sacrifices it to Village Rites' additional cost. A player sacrifices only a permanent they control (CR 701.21a), so seat 0 sacrificed it, and seat 0's Havoc Jester triggers: 1 damage to seat 1. The Ogre goes to its owner's graveyard (CR 400.3). Before engine wave E3 the binder read the sacrificing player off the battlefield the Ogre was filed under, its owner's, and the Jester did not trigger.
